newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus court jails Briton for burglaries.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus court jails Briton for burglaries.

text.p: A Briton was jailed for two years by a Cyprus court on Thursday for going on a burglary spree in a tourist area of the holiday island last year.
Christopher John Nagar, 20, unemployed from London, pleaded guilty to 12 counts of burglary in the south eastern district of Famagusta.
Nagar's accomplice Lee Marios Kyriakou, an 18-year-old Briton of Cypriot descent, was given an 18-month sentence suspended for three years and a 1000 Cyprus pound (1,200 pound sterling) fine.
